formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Data Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on A8.1-A8.3.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can sort, count, and graph.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can sort, count, and graph.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: Sort the 6 shapes into 2 groups by colour.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. Sort with 6 shapes.

image_placeholders.description: A sort task in B&W, ~6in x 2in. 6 shapes drawn (3 red, 3 blue). 2 sort circles. Header 'Sort by colour:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_SORT: keywords (sort) name the activity.

prompts.answer_key: 3 red in one circle, 3 blue in the other.

prompts.prompt: Count and tally: there are 5 cats and 3 dogs. Show tallies.

image_placeholders.description: A tally chart in B&W, ~6in x 1.5in. 2 rows: cats, dogs. Tally areas. Header 'Tally:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_TALLY: keywords (tally) name the chart.

prompts.prompt: Make a pictograph from the tallies.

image_placeholders.description: A 2-row pictograph template in B&W, ~6in x 1.5in. Header 'Pictograph:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_GRAPH: keywords (pictograph) name the chart.

prompts.answer_key: Cat row: 5 stickers. Dog row: 3 stickers.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, or TRY AGAIN.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Three faces in a row labelled GOT IT, ALMOST, and TRY AGAIN.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row in B&W. Smile labelled GOT IT, neutral labelled ALMOST, frown labelled TRY AGAIN.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q4_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Score: sort + tally + graph = ready for Lesson 4.

reflection_sheet.title: My Detective Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Detective Dot holding a Junior Data Detective certificate. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Data Detective? Circle one.
prompts.visual_layout: Top of page. Three star-rating ovals.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Detective!'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.description: A 5-row YES/NO table in B&W. Rows: 'I sorted things', 'I counted with tallies', 'I made a pictograph', 'I read a graph', 'I did a class survey'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE detective task?

image_placeholders.description: Five icons in B&W: sort, tally, pictograph, read graph, class survey. Each ~1in x 1in with selection bubble.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (icons) name the five options.

prompts.visual_layout: Lower-middle. Three tricky-moment cards in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Sorting', 'Tallying', 'Graphing'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to investigate NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in B&W. Each ~1.5in x 1.5in. Labels: 'Snacks', 'Sports', 'Pets'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at end of Lesson 5 after the certificate ceremony.
